name: shell
title: App shell
description: Inset sidebar that collapses to icons, workspace switcher, user menu with light/dark/system theme, header with breadcrumbs and Ctrl/Cmd+K command menu, page header. Replaces app/layout.tsx with Inter + Geist Mono, ThemeProvider (system default), TooltipProvider and Toaster.
